name: keyblaze
description: Make Every Keystroke Count. Particle bursts, fire, lightning, fireworks, combos and cursor effects as you type, built on supported VS Code APIs.

keyblaze.preset.markdownDescription: Animation preset. A preset supplies the effect, colours, shape and particle values. Any of those settings that you set explicitly **override** the preset. `custom` uses only your own settings and the built-in defaults.

enumDescriptions: Particle explosion bursting from the cursor.
Small, subtle sparks with minimal distraction.
keyblaze.effect.markdownDescription: Typing effect. Overrides the active `#keyblaze.preset#` when set.

keyblaze.intensity.markdownDescription: Overall effect intensity (1–10). Scales spread, glow and energy. Overrides the preset when set.

keyblaze.particleCount.markdownDescription: Particles spawned per keystroke, before performance limits (1–40). Overrides the preset when set.

keyblaze.particleSize.markdownDescription: Base particle size in pixels. Overrides the preset when set.

keyblaze.particleSpeed.markdownDescription: Particle speed multiplier. Overrides the preset when set.

keyblaze.particleLifetime.markdownDescription: How long a burst lives, in milliseconds. Overrides the preset when set.

keyblaze.particleShape.markdownDescription: Particle shape. Overrides the preset when set.

items.patternErrorMessage: Use a hex colour such as #ff8a00.

keyblaze.colors.markdownDescription: Particle colour palette (hex colours). Overrides the preset when set.

keyblaze.triggerOnDelete.description: Also trigger effects for Backspace and Delete.

enumDescriptions: Full-circle effects centred on the cursor where the layout allows it, otherwise rising effects on the cursor line.
Always place rising effects on the cursor line. Use this with editor font zoom, proportional fonts or other layouts where full-circle effects appear misplaced.
keyblaze.placement.markdownDescription: How effects are attached to the cursor. VS Code can only draw decoration images upward from the text baseline, so full-circle effects are drawn from a few lines below the cursor. `auto` falls back to rising effects on the cursor line next to wide characters (CJK, emoji), inlay hints, wrapped or folded lines and at the end of the document.

keyblaze.cursor.effect.markdownDescription: Extra effect around the typing cursor. Overrides the preset when set.

keyblaze.combo.resetTime.description: Milliseconds of inactivity before the combo resets.

keyblaze.combo.showIndicator.description: Show the animated combo indicator at the end of the cursor line.

keyblaze.combo.showInStatusBar.description: Show the current combo in the status bar.

keyblaze.combo.milestones.description: Combo counts that trigger a milestone celebration.

keyblaze.screenShake.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable **Impact Pulse** on combo milestones. The effect layer and combo badge shake, and the cursor line can flash. The editor text never moves, because moving it reliably would need unsupported hacks.

keyblaze.screenShake.intensity.description: Impact Pulse strength (1–10). Larger milestones shake harder.

keyblaze.screenShake.flashLine.description: Briefly flash the cursor line during an Impact Pulse.

keyblaze.sound.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable synthesised sound effects. They play through the **KeyBlaze Sound** view in the Explorer (command: *KeyBlaze: Open Sound View*), which must be opened and clicked once per session because of the browser autoplay policy. Sounds are paused while a screen reader is in use (see `#keyblaze.accessibility.disableWithScreenReader#`).

enumDescriptions: Play sounds only on combo milestones.
Play a subtle sound on every keystroke.

keyblaze.performanceMode.description: Low-spec mode: fewer particles, simpler animation and stricter limits.

keyblaze.performance.maxConcurrentBursts.description: Maximum number of bursts on screen at once. The oldest burst is recycled first.

keyblaze.performance.maxBurstsPerSecond.description: Maximum bursts started per second, evenly paced: in very fast typing, bursts render on every second keystroke. Every keystroke still counts towards combos.

keyblaze.performance.frameRateLimit.description: Frame-rate cap for the Control Panel preview. Animation in the editor is driven by the editor's renderer.

keyblaze.performance.quality.description: Animation quality: more keyframes and glow at higher levels.

keyblaze.accessibility.respectReducedMot.markdownDescription: Use calm, low-motion effects when `#workbench.reduceMotion#` is `on`, or when it is `auto` and the OS requests reduced motion. Low motion means tiny sparks, no Impact Pulse, no pulsing and no badge pop. The OS preference is detected by KeyBlaze's webviews (Control Panel or Sound view), so `auto` takes effect once one of them has been opened.

keyblaze.accessibility.disableWithScreen.markdownDescription: Pause all KeyBlaze effects, combos and sounds while screen-reader optimisation (`#editor.accessibilitySupport#`) is `on`.

keyblaze.excludeLanguages.description: Language IDs where KeyBlaze is disabled, for example "markdown" or "plaintext".

keyblaze.excludeFiles.description: Glob patterns for files where KeyBlaze is disabled, for example "**/*.min.js".

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run compile-tests && vscode-test --label stable
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:visual: npm run build && npm run compile-tests && node test/visual/verify-placement.mjs && node test/visual/verify-combo.mjs && node test/visual/verify-panel.mjs && node test/visual/verify-sound.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: npm run compile-tests && c8 --include "out/src/**" --exclude "out/src/webview/**" --reporter=text-summary --reporter=text mocha --ui tdd "out/test/unit/**/*.test.js"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:min-vscode: npm run build && npm run compile-tests && vscode-test --label minimum
